_comment: Food photography used inside the rendered app screenshots. Unsplash IDs only — the generator fetches them into cache/ at build time and they are never committed. Unsplash License: free for commercial use, no attribution required. Each entry was picked by eye to match the meal it is labelled as; if you swap an ID, look at the photo first and update the meal name to match.

buddha-bowl.shows: Top-down grain bowl — avocado, chickpeas, roast sweet potato, watermelon radish, tomato, mango

salmon.shows: Pan-seared salmon fillet over wilted greens with cucumber salsa, dark restaurant setting

cookies.shows: Chocolate chip cookies in a bowl on dark cloth
